published.source: master after raid buffs took Forever's ranks (shaman audit 10.2), 2026-10-15

summary: The same Shadow points with 20 Holy points of healing utility instead of Discipline, giving up Twin Disciplines and Mental Strength. Shipped as a second Shadow preset for raids that want the Holy utility, 2.5% behind Level 60 at 180 s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -3 s, Mind Blast at -1.5 s that lands at the pull
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 40% mana; racials on cooldown
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left in the fight)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down and off its 1 min cooldown (12+ s left)
Inner Focus right before Mind Blast
Mind Blast on cooldown, then Shadow Word: Death on cooldown
Mind Flay to fill; clipped after the second tick if SW:P or Devouring Plague fell off, never clipped for Mind Blast
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
The 20 Holy points add no DPS (healing utility only)
Runs low on mana on long fights; Greater Mageblood Elixir keeps it (without it 300 s fell to 821 on the earlier gear); Gnome is 0.3 behind Undead at 180 s but 21.8 at 300 s
Synthetic Phase 1 gear (not in the game), only the 2-piece set bonus is live; Raiments 4/5-piece would add +40.2 DPS (+4.7%, Devouring Plague without a cooldown)
Periodic spells roll crit per tick (global Forever rule); Shadow Weaving assumed to apply to the priest's own Shadow damage on every target
Mind Flay rolls hit once and its channel is not hasted; SW:Death backlash ignored and SW:Death numbers are untested in beta
Brilliant Wizard Oil left out as a Zul'Gurub recipe (+12.5); Elixir of Sages left out by the one-crit-elixir ruling (+13.9)
notes: mksettings request plus manaRegenElixir GreaterMagebloodElixir (ConsumesHoly in presets.ts). Only the Undead number is published for this build; no per-faction race table.
